snippet.title: Janet De Mornay Is A Slumlord (and a Witch) Release Platforms Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Filthy renters take note! Escape room comedy-horror Janet DeMornay Is A Slumlord (and a witch) is coming in 2026, to PC, Mac, and PlayStation 5!
RENT MONEY IS DEAD MONEY and your landlord is expecting payment IN FULL. Puzzle your way out of a maze of DEPRAVED magical appliances and the UNHINGED diaries of a DEBAUCHED faded television celebrity.

Set in a crumbling Sydney terrace the Fuzzy Ghost boys rented for many years - JDM is an escape room, comedy-horror with a classic survival-horror, set camera. Inspired by films Beetlejuice and Poltergeist, and games like Resident Evil 2 (without the zombies), it’s a ridiculous but horrifyingly relevant story about found-family, queer lives, landlord overreach, and television shopping network divas.

Wishlist Janet De Mornay is a Slumlord )and a Witch) now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168480/Janet_DeMornay_Is_A_Slumlord_and_a_witch/
